title: Drone LiDAR finds 3 unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in Australian bushland
summary: Researchers utilized drone technology to discover three previously unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in the Blue Mountains region, revealing significant cultural heritage. Collaboration with the Dharug Custodian Aboriginal Corporation ensured accurate documentation of red hand stencils and stone artifacts. This innovative approach may improve archaeological surveys in difficult-to-navigate areas, thereby preserving cultural heritage. Ongoing efforts will assess the method's applicability to different Australian landscapes, ensuring continued protection.

items.title: Drone LiDAR finds 3 unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in Australian bushland

title: Houthi attack on Saudi oil giant raises global energy concerns
summary: The conflict in Yemen has entered a dangerous new phase after Iran-backed Houthi rebels targeted the headquarters of Saudi oil giant Aramco in Dhahran. While there were no reported fatalities, the strike damaged parts of the company’s headquarters and highlighted the Houthis’ growing ability to hit strategic targets deep inside Saudi Arabia. The attack comes amid renewed fighting in Yemen, repeated strikes on Saudi infrastructure and growing concerns over regional stability, global energy supplies and the risk of a wider Middle East conflict.
